name: IHL - Post Outbound GHL Disposition to LeadMailbox

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, dry_run: true, ready: $json.ready, leadid: $json.leadid, disposition_in: $json.disposition_in, status_key: $json.status_key, status_value: $json.status_value, booked: $json.booked, patch_body: $json.patch_body }) }}

parameters.content:
## IHL - LeadMailbox disposition write-back

GHL fires this after each AI call.

Send in customData: leadid, stage_name (disposition), summary, transcript_url, recording_url, appointment, note_html.

DRY_RUN=true previews the exact PATCH body without calling LeadMailbox or advancing round-robin.

Before live: set LMB_API_ACCOUNT=IHLI01 and LMB_API_KEY (rotated); confirm Dan's call_status value enum + the two bucket status names exist in LMB; then flip DRY_RUN false.
